purpose: Test stellar structure and selection before using brown-dwarf counts; not a formal IMF posterior.
birth_population: Same field-normalized component IMF as v1; independent seeds 41, 42, 43, with paired seeds across clusters.

structural_screen.meaning: Broad screening ranges, not Gaussian errors or a fitted prior. Mass includes white dwarfs but excludes black holes and neutron stars; report both total and nonremnant mass. Radius is measured in the same aperture. Compare all model results, not only passing runs.

stellar_holdout: Compare absolute reference-star counts and disjoint radial bins independently of BD counts. Do not freely rescale the simulated population to fit the ratio.
survey_tests: Original full candidate union, retaining all associated and tidal-tail candidates as the scientific target.
Pleiades DANCe selected members (pc > 0.84), theta < 3 degrees, observed Ks < 17; synthetic sources use the same aperture and magnitude cut.
Apply published DANCe classifier recovery only within the observed survey, never as correction for unobserved tails. Aggregate classifier rates are not mass-dependent calibrations.
not_fitted: arbitrary global membership probability for the union
